frozen_on: 2026-11-23, before any verifier or solver run with a model server on the node
approved_by_user: 2026-11-23 (interference check, one solver run on m256, final score with the node idle)
questions: How far do the in-session scores (submit.sh) move when a model server holds GPUs 4-7 of the node?
Can Qwen3.8-27B driven by mini-swe-agent run the m256 task end to end inside the Apptainer image, and what does it score?
task: mi210-jais3-moe-m256, the package in work_datasets/phibench-mi210-rows (Erland/phibench-mi210-rows commit 323e515)
where: auh7-1b-gpu-240 (Slurm job 519331, all 8 MI210s); task on HIP device 0; one GPU job at a time under the lock /tmp/phibench-auh7-240-gpus.lock

model_server.model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (Hugging Face, BF16, 27.8B parameters), text only (--language-model-only)
model_server.serving: vLLM 0.32.0 from $WORK/phibench-apptainer/images/vllm-openai-rocm-v0.32.0.sif, scripts/serve_qwen.sh, tensor parallel 4 on HIP devices 4,5,6,7, max context 131072, gpu-memory-utilization 0.90, reasoning parser qwen3
model_server.sampling: temperature 0.6, other settings at the server's defaults (generation_config.json of the model)

step_1_interference.what: scripts/score_once.sh on GPU 0 with the server up and idle on GPUs 4-7: noop x1, then oracle x1
step_1_interference.busy_check: every GPU except 4-7 idle before and after each run; GPUs 4-7 are expected to hold the server's memory
step_1_interference.compare_to: the idle-node Apptainer runs of 2026-11-23: noop 1.005598, oracle 1.211459
step_1_interference.pass_marks: none; this measures the shift and is reported as is

step_2_solver.agent: mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 ($WORK/venvs/mini-swe-agent), DefaultAgent, text-based actions (one bash block per reply), LitellmTextbasedModel against the local server
step_2_solver.environment: mini-swe-agent SingularityEnvironment with the apptainer executable: a writable sandbox copy of the task image, each command `apptainer exec --fakeroot --contain --cleanenv --no-home --writable`, /dev/kfd and /dev/dri bound, a host directory at /tmp, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, working directory /app/repo
step_2_solver.prompt: instruction.md verbatim, followed by mini-swe-agent's action-format rules and how to end (run `bash /opt/loop/submit.sh --finalize`, then `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`); nothing else about the task
step_2_solver.limits: wall time 14400 s (task.toml agent timeout_sec), 1800 s per command, no step limit, 16 scored submissions (the task's own limit), the run ends early if the context window is exceeded
step_2_solver.record: the full trajectory (every model message and command output) and /logs of the sandbox

step_3_final_score.what: stop the server; check every GPU idle; if the solver made at least one submission but did not finalize, run `bash /opt/loop/submit.sh --finalize` in the sandbox (the harness's auto-finalize); then `bash /tests/test.sh` (candidate mode) in the solver's sandbox with tests/ at /tests read-only; check every GPU idle after
step_3_final_score.zero_submissions: the working tree is scored as left

audit: grep the trajectory for any read of /opt/loop/private, /tests or the patches; report what is found, do not change the score
not_a_claim: one solver run on one task: it shows the setup works and gives one score, not the model's skill
stop_on: a GPU outside 4-7 busy before or after a timing run
an unexpected execution failure of the setup (not of the solver)
